name: Hope & Main
old_description: Join us for a packed session designed to answer your biggest questions and help you take the first step to start or grow your food biz dreams!
about:
Hope & Main operates from Warren, Rhode Island, where it was founded in 2014 as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit culinary incubator. The organization emerged to address the high barriers food entrepreneurs face when launching products, offering shared commercial kitchen space and structured business support.

The incubator provides a tiered co-packing service alongside its flagship Warren kitchens, with a second location, West End Kitchens, slated to open in 2026. Since inception, the program has helped launch more than 550 food and beverage businesses, giving members access to production facilities without the capital expense of equipping and maintaining their own plants.

Clients are early-stage food and beverage entrepreneurs seeking to test, scale, or pivot products. The incubator serves makers across categories such as packaged foods, beverages, and specialty items, connecting them with educators, industry professionals, and a marketplace at 100 Westminster Street in Providence.

The organization states its mission is to empower an inclusive community of entrepreneurs to build a more just, sustainable, and resilient local food economy. It positions itself as an integrated resource system, a community of educators, and an advocacy voice for small food businesses.
